test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The mean of ages of 9 children in a joint family is 14 years. The ages of their grandfather and grandmother are 71 years and 67 years respectively. Find the mean of the ages of children and grandparents.
solution:
**Given:**

The mean of 9 children = 14 years 

Age of grandfather = 71 years 

Age of grandmother = 67 years 

**Formula used:**

Mean Age = (Total age of persons)/(Number of persons)

Calculation:

Mean of the ages of 9 children and grandparents = (14 years × 9 + 71 years + 67 years)/(9 + 2) 

⇒ 264/11 

⇒ 24 years 

**∴ The mean of the ages of children and grandparents is 24 years.**
